title: Reserve our Sandy Souls Cottage | Cottage Rental Rosemary Beach | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Perfectly located South of 30A

Sandy Souls Cottage is a beautiful 3 bedroom, 3 bath home. A brief two block stroll down the boardwalk to the sparkling waters of the Gulf of Mexico and one block from restaurants and boutiques in the town square, Sandy Souls Cottage is ideally situated for you to enjoy all the charms of Rosemary Beach.

The first floor offers a master bedroom with ensuite bathroom, guest bedroom, children’s bunk room with double built in bunk beds and a trundle and guest bathroom.

The second floor living room is a light, airy space with soaring 20’ ceilings and lined by French doors which lead out to the decks and outdoor dining cabana. The roomy open floor plan is perfect for large family gatherings. It offers a spacious, comfortable living area and dining room, kitchen with additional island seating and a guest bathroom and laundry.

The third floor balcony with serene Gulf views is the perfect place to enjoy a morning cup of coffee or glass of wine while admiring the stunning sunsets. The third floor loft also has a sleeping area.

THIS PROPERTY RENTS SATURDAY - SATURDAY IN SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER. ONLINE RESERVATIONS SUBJECT TO CHANGE.
